result.instructions: Tools for Paperform, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Paperform data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run paperform_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run paperform_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run paperform_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. paperform_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: paperform_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in the Paperform account (id, slug, custom_slug, title, url, live, tags, submission_count, space_id, dates), newest first. Search by title, or also by slug/custom_slug with search_fields. Start here to find the slug or id the other tools need. Paperform: GET /forms.

search.description: Text to match (partial, case-insensitive) — the form title unless search_fields says otherwise.

search_fields.description: Which fields `search` matches: any of title, slug, custom_slug (default title only).

skip.description: Results to skip (offset). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

after_id.description: Cursor: only results after this id (e.g. the previous reply's last_id).

before_id.description: Cursor: only results before this id.

after_date.description: Only results created after this ISO 8601 date-time (UTC). Ignored by Paperform when after_id is set.

before_date.description: Only results created before this ISO 8601 date-time (UTC). Ignored by Paperform when before_id is set.

sort.description: Sort by created_at: DESC (default, newest first) or ASC.

tools.name: paperform_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Fetch one form by slug, custom slug or id: title, description, url, live flag, tags, submission_count, space and dates. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}.

form.description: The form's slug, custom slug or id (from paperform_list_forms).

tools.name: paperform_list_form_fields
tools.title: List form fields
tools.description: List a form's questions (key, title, type, required, custom_key, description, options). The field keys are the keys of a submission's `data` object, so read this to interpret answers. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/fields.

form.description: The form's slug, custom slug or id (from paperform_list_forms).

search.description: Only fields whose name matches this text.

tools.name: paperform_create_coupon
tools.title: Create a form coupon
tools.description: WRITE: create a coupon code on a form, with a fixed discountAmount or a discountPercentage (not both), an optional target (price or subscription) and expiry. Respondents can use it at checkout as soon as it is enabled. Undo: paperform_update_coupon with enabled=false. Paperform: POST /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons.

form.description: The form's slug, custom slug or id (from paperform_list_forms).

code.description: The new coupon code, e.g. SPRING20.

enabled.description: Whether respondents can use the coupon.

target.description: What the discount applies to: the one-off price or a subscription.

discountAmount.description: A fixed discount, in the form's currency (e.g. 10 = 10.00).

expiresAt.description: When the coupon expires (ISO 8601 with a timezone), or null for no expiry.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z (sent to Paperform in UTC).

tools.name: paperform_update_coupon
tools.title: Update a form coupon
tools.description: WRITE: change a coupon on a form — enable or disable it, change its discount (amount or percentage), target or expiry (null = never expires). Only the fields you pass are sent. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons/{code}.

form.description: The form's slug, custom slug or id (from paperform_list_forms).

enabled.description: Whether respondents can use the coupon.

target.description: What the discount applies to: the one-off price or a subscription.

discountAmount.description: A fixed discount, in the form's currency (e.g. 10 = 10.00).

expiresAt.description: When the coupon expires (ISO 8601 with a timezone), or null for no expiry.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z (sent to Paperform in UTC).

tools.name: paperform_set_product_quantity
tools.title: Set a product's stock quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set how many units of a form product are available (its stock quantity), e.g. after restocking. Replaces the current value; read it first with paperform_get_product. Not atomic: it overwrites rather than adjusts, so a sale between your read and this write is lost. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/products/{sku}/quantity.

form.description: The form's slug, custom slug or id (from paperform_list_forms).

quantity.description: The new stock quantity (0 or more).

tools.name: paperform_set_product_sold
tools.title: Set a product's sold count
tools.description: WRITE: set the number of units of a form product recorded as sold (e.g. to correct it after a refund or an offline sale). Replaces the current value; read it first with paperform_get_product. Not atomic: it overwrites rather than adjusts, so a sale between your read and this write is lost. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/products/{sku}/sold.

form.description: The form's slug, custom slug or id (from paperform_list_forms).

sold.description: The new sold count (0 or more).
